title.zh: 宣布每年9月17日为锡基霍尔省特别非工作公共假日，名称为锡基霍尔日的法案
title.en: An Act to Declare the Seventeenth Day of September of Every Year as a Nonworking Special Public Holiday for the Province of Siquijor to Be Known as Siquijor Day
title.orig: An Act to Declare the Seventeenth Day of September of Every Year as a Nonworking Special Public Holiday for the Province of Siquijor to Be Known as Siquijor Day

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7673_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Republic Act No. 63 98 which created Siquijor Island into a province was enacted and signed by then President Ferdinand E. Marcos on September 17, 1971.
The seventeenth day of September of every year is hereby declared a nonworking special public holiday for the Province of Siquijor to be known as Siquijor Day.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
